title: LiteMedCoT-VL: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation for Medical Visual Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2605.09384v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The reasoning gap between large and compact vision-language models (VLMs) limits the deployment of medical AI on portable clinical devices. Compact VLMs of 2-4B parameters can run on resource-constrained hardware but lack the multi-step reasoning capacity needed for interpretable clinical decision support. Existing knowledge distillation methods transfer answers without the reasoning process behind them. Medical visual question answering (VQA) serves as a testbed for this problem, as it requires models to integrate visual evidence with clinical knowledge through structured reasoning chains. We introduce LiteMedCoT-VL, a pipeline that transfers chain-of-thought reasoning from a 235B teacher model to 2B student models through LoRA-based fine-tuning on explanation-enriched training data. translated_title: LiteMedCoT-VL：面向医学视觉问答的参数高效适配
translated_abstract: 大型视觉语言模型与紧凑型视觉语言模型之间的推理能力差距，限制了医疗AI在便携式临床设备上的部署。参数量为2-4B的紧凑型视觉语言模型可以在资源受限的硬件上运行，但缺乏可解释临床决策支持所需的多步推理能力。现有的知识蒸馏方法只传递答案，却不传递答案背后的推理过程。医学视觉问答（VQA）可以作为该问题的测试平台，因为它要求模型通过结构化推理链将视觉证据与临床知识相结合。我们提出了LiteMedCoT-VL，这是一个流水线方法，通过在解释丰富的训练数据上进行基于LoRA的微调，将思维链推理能力从235B的教师模型迁移到2B的学生模型。所有推理默认在不使用图像描述的情况下进行，以模拟医生直接解读医学图像的临床场景（原文摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出LiteMedCoT-VL方法，通过LoRA微调和解释丰富的训练数据，将235B教师模型的思维链推理能力高效迁移到2B学生模型，从而在参数高效的条件下实现具备可解释推理能力的医学视觉问答。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes LiteMedCoT-VL, a pipeline that transfers chain-of-thought reasoning from a 235B teacher model to 2B student models via LoRA-based fine-tuning on explanation-enriched data, enabling parameter-efficient adaptation for medical visual question answering.
